mapper.select: SELECT A.PROD_ID as prodId, A.VDATE as prdVDate, A.MDATE as prdMDate, A.holdDate, B.REG_CODE as prdRegistCode FROM objRec A LEFT JOIN CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE B ON A.PROD_ID = B.PRODID LEFT JOIN CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB_SUM C ON (A.PROD_ID = C.PRODID AND A.holdDate = STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(C.HOLD_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d'), '%Y-%m-%d') ) WHERE C.PRODID is null
